decisions.reason: As a core construction vehicle with sunk engineering investment, its centrality leads management to continue despite limited public commitment.
The product has a dedicated page and visible commitment, and while furniture lifts are somewhat peripheral, invested resources and public presence justify continued support.
This building material lift is central to the announced direction and has a dedicated page, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
The truck-mounted furniture lift combines vehicle and lifting competencies with public commitment, and management persists due to sunk costs and justification.
